summary: fix(settings): repair ScanQR and AppLayout tests broken on main
description:
Because:

- The ScanQR test expects firefox-logo-browser.svg, but the page uses
  firefox-logo-bw.svg.
- AppLayout calls window.location.pathname.startsWith, which throws when the
  App and CookiesDisabled tests mock window.location without pathname.

This commit:

- Expects firefox-logo-bw.svg in the ScanQR logo test.
- Guards the AppLayout mobile pairing check with optional chaining.

Closes FXA-14770
